title: EtaleLimitCompatibleExactSystems
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D an inverse diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme], c a cone, and F_i abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with coherent inverse-image transitions phi [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let G be their pullback diagram on c.pt, with coherent object identifications eG, and L a colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. There exist coherent systems FI_i of injective sheaves [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and FR_i of quotient sheaves, their pullback diagrams GI and GR, and colimit cocones LI and LR; stage short exact sequences [def-sp-abelian] F_i -> FI_i -> FR_i and a limit short exact sequence L.pt -> LI.pt -> LR.pt; morphisms r along every stage transition whose three components are phi, psi, and phiR; and morphisms t from each pulled-back stage short complex to the limit short complex whose three components are eG_i.inv followed by L.iota_i, eGI_i.inv followed by LI.iota_i, and eGR_i.inv followed by LR.iota_i. All FI_i are injective. No cohomology maps or exact cohomology rows are asserted. The existence is expressed in continuation form: every proposition implied by such data holds.

source.place: Product-of-direct-images construction; cokernels and exact filtered colimits in the dimension-shifting argument of 09YP

proof.text: Apply etale_coefficient_injective_cokernel_system to obtain the coherent injective and cokernel coefficient systems, stage short exact sequences, injectivity, and the two transition squares. Define r with components phi, psi and phiR; the squares are exactly its commutation fields.

Apply etale_system_cone_functor to each of the two new coefficient systems, obtaining GI, GR and their coherent object isomorphisms. Define alpha and beta by conjugating the pulled-back stage maps through eG, eGI and eGR. Their naturality follows by the supplied diagram arrow equations, the stage squares, and naturality of upperStarComp. Their composite is zero objectwise.

Define s from each pulled-back stage short complex to the component short complex using all three inverse object identifications. Each component of s is invertible. Exact inverse image transports the stage short exact sequence, so the component sequence is short exact by this isomorphism. Evaluations jointly reflect isomorphisms; JointlyReflectIsomorphisms.shortExact_iff proves the functor-category short complex ShortComplex.mk alpha beta w is short exact.

Use the actual colimit cocones LI and LR. Identify colimit G with the supplied colimit L by its unique colimit isomorphism e. Set a=e.inv followed by colim.map alpha, and b=colim.map beta. Functoriality gives a followed by b zero. Apply the exact filtered colimit functor to the diagram short complex, then transport short exactness across ShortComplex.isoMk e (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _). Exactness is supplied by Mathlib Sheaf.hasExactColimitsOfShape with AB5OfSize at the smaller index universe.

Construct q from the component short complex to the limit short complex using the supplied L coprojection and the actual GI and GR colimit coprojections. The first square follows from the colimit-point isomorphism coprojection equation and colimit.iota_map; the second is colimit.iota_map. Put t_i=s_i followed by q_i. All three components of t and all three components of r have the required values definitionally. Supply these witnesses and injectivity to the continuation.

proof_origin.place: X3, 2026-10-13: scheme-specific coefficient construction and cone functor; explicit functor-category assembly and exact filtered colimits as in 09YP. Assembly follows the proved EtaleReplacementStageDiagram and EtaleLimitReplacementExactSystems, retaining all three comparison components and stage morphisms.
